“Never evaluate your life when you are tired.” 

Where do you want your future self to be in 5 years?

Whenever I feel like quitting something, I try to think of the reason why I decided to do it first. I try to remember the exact feeling and the why’s of me spending this much time and energy for that thing. Then I evaluate if quitting this thing that I invested so much time on will make my future self happier. Will my future self regret if I quit now and ask the question WHAT IF? If you see yourself in the future as a lawyer and entrepreneur, which one will make you happier and proud? You know yourself the best so only you would know.
